items.caption_zh: 图11 本项目ResNet18的标准Grad-CAM计算机制示意。前向取得目标类别分数，解释路径先对梯度作空间平均，再用所得通道权重组合特征，经过ReLU后，先上采样至输入尺寸，再逐图归一化并叠加到输入。本图说明计算机制，不给出六类手势识别成绩。
items.caption_en: Figure 11. Standard Grad-CAM computation for the project’s ResNet18. The forward pass obtains the target class score. The explanation path spatially averages the gradients and uses the resulting channel weights to combine features. After ReLU, the map is first upsampled to the input size, then normalized separately and overlaid on the input. This figure explains the computation and does not report six-class gesture-recognition performance.
